plan: Deep-copy and index the recursive agenda by permanent item numbers, including top-level ancestry and consent membership.
Validate each command atomically, aggregate all errors, and append only valid chronological events.
Build six deterministic projections with ISO timestamps, vote outcomes, action filtering, and recess-adjusted duration comparisons.

trace.source_relation: Agenda item numbers are unique permanent references that survive reorder and withdrawal.
trace.target_mechanism: Recursive number index plus separate mutable order and withdrawn-state collections.

trace.source_relation: Invalid calls must report all applicable errors without altering the five document views.
trace.target_mechanism: Per-call validation gathers every error before an atomic state or event update.

trace.source_relation: Public and chair views differ in private notes, actions, and consent membership.
trace.target_mechanism: A recursive projection strips private fields and conditionally annotates chair copies.

trace.source_relation: Actual duration runs between item proceedings and excludes recess overlap.
trace.target_mechanism: Top-level proceeding intervals are derived from motion/vote timestamps and intersected with stored recess intervals.

trace.source_relation: Inputs must not be mutated and repeated document calls must be stable.
trace.target_mechanism: Constructor and command payloads are deep-copied; documents are recomputed as detached projections.
